description: Control your ILEVIA home-automation system from ChatGPT: lights, shutters, thermostats and scenarios; live and historical energy data (photovoltaic production, consumption, grid import/export); schedules; irrigation; Sony TVs and Sonos speakers. The app operates exclusively on the user's own plant, linked once via QR code or serial+key at login.
